Resolves #20173

🌿 *neo's agent reviews are now judged by the policy Skills publishes, so a fix to it can no longer miss neo.*

This deletes the 605-line inline `agent-pr-review-body-lint.yml` and adds a 23-line `pr-review.yml`. The new file calls `reusable-pr-review.yml@v0.1.74` with `budget_activation_issue: 15257`, the Skills caller's trigger and grant, and no other change. The inline copy had drifted from the package it was extracted from: it still carried the polynomial `**Status:**` capture that CodeQL flagged there, it named retired handles, and it stacked a new comment on every failing run. The check stays informative, and no required check changes.

Evidence: L3 for AC-2 and AC-3 (three live review events on this PR) and L2 for the cohort resolution (the published 0.1.74 CLI run on #15257's live closing history). Residual: the live Request Changes cohort read, which needs another seat's review and is listed under Post-Merge Validation. `agent-preflight`: not hosted here (no script in neo's `package.json`); the baseline jobs run instead. Change class: zero-delta (`ci`).

Related: neomjs/neo-agent-skills#14 · neomjs/neo-agent-skills#233 · neomjs/neo-agent-skills#236 · neomjs/neo-agent-skills#80 · neomjs/neo-agent-skills#144

An edit that still failed updated that comment at 13:34:04Z instead of adding one ([run](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/40883059918)). ## Deltas from ticket
AC-2 is narrowed in the ticket body. The policy evaluates the activation cohort only for a Request Changes (`judgeReview`, `check-pr-review-body.mjs:440`), which an author cannot post on their own PR. The live read and grant are proven here; the live resolution moves to Post-Merge Validation.

## Test Evidence
Intake: `Prescription checked: neomjs/neo-agent-skills .github/workflows/reusable-pr-review.yml + scripts/check-pr-review-body.mjs @v0.1.74 — owns the concern.` A synced inline copy would keep the drift, and an org-level required workflow is unavailable on the free plan.

The history `closedByPullRequestsReferences` returns for #15257 is complete: `totalCount: 1`, `hasNextPage: false`, #15307 merged into `dev` at 2026-07-16T20:54:31Z. The installed `neo-agent-skills-pr-review-body@0.1.74` judged three synthetic Request Changes envelopes against it:

| Envelope | Verdict |
|---|---|
| PR created 2026-10-29, live history | `BUDGET_PROVENANCE_MISSING`: the cohort resolved as post-activation |
| PR created 2026-07-01, live history | `TEMPLATE_INCOMPLETE`: budget-exempt, falls through to the template check |
| Same history with `hasNextPage: true` (control) | `BUDGET_ACTIVATION_UNPROVABLE` |
